answer: Each epoch the network samples 0.1 of settled answers for independent re-grading, and a grader whose score diverges from the sampled verdict is suspended for 6 epochs. A sybil that approves planted junk faces a knoll detection probability per round, so the expected fine outpaces any anchor-ledger bribe income. The system verifies by re-examining sealed grades against seeded honeypots drawn from the crystal-grade audit pool.
